invariants.rationale: The origin typically expects finite coordinates; this checks that 'y' is not infinity or NaN.
All float values except for NaN and negative infinity are above NEGATIVE_INFINITY, which can sometimes capture edge-case handling for lower bounds.
Ensures 'y' is not beyond positive infinity, holding for all valid float values except NaN.
It is impossible for 'y' to be both less than and greater than zero at the same time, hinting at numeric sanity.
